Name: Change Dialogues plus SVE - CFD - LfL - Razolyn - Robin Romance Mod - Jodi Datable - True Love Valley - Farmerjack's Dialogue Expansions - Dateable Caroline - Marry Morris and Sam After Dark
Author: mardrest
Description:
It is a mod that changes the names, boys can change to girls and girls to boys.
When changing sex, the dialogues automatically change regardless of who you change, one or all of them.
You can also exchange worms for a chest.
And now you can change Dusty Name, Portrait and Sprite.

There are 4 types of configuration in the config file that is placed on the folder "ChangeDialogues" :
1. Change the Name, like "AbigailName": "Anna", there are special ones like "AbigailNickname" or "SamLongname".
2. Change the Gender like "ClintGender": "Female" or "Male".
3. Change the sprites like "CarolineSprite": "New" for the modified sprites, "Vanilla" remain the Vanilla sprites or "Other" if you have an Mod that change the sprites.
4. Change the portrait like "CarolinePortrait": "HighRes" for the HighRes portrait, "New" for the modified portrait, "Vanilla" remain the Vanilla Portrait or "Other" if you have an Mod that change the portrait.

There's a new option HighRes for High Resolution Portraits. The mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]ScaleUp Unofficial[/url] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/65169671]Arborsm[/url] have to be installed to work. I have added High Res Portraits of Alex (Female) from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2208150]moirgane[/url]. Abigail, Jas and Sandy from [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/junminami.491906/]JunMinami[/url].

[b]To use High Portraits, there are those I added, set like for Abigail "AbigailSprite"; "HighRes".
If you wan't to add your Portrait, for example for Sam as Female, put the file on the Portraits folder naming it "SamFemaleHighRes.png" [/b][b]and set on the configuration "SamSprite": "HighRes",

I added HighRes Portraits from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/78766618]talkohlooeys[/url][/b], big thanks to him for the awesome Portraits.

I used sprites from other known mods and I edited some of them.
The credits are on <Permissions and Credits>.


[b]Now threre's a option to make your own Sprite and Portrait Pack.[/b]
To work the folder name should have first "[CHD]" as prefix and the name of the pack.
- Inside have to be the content.json and manifest.json with changeDialogues as Dependency.
- The name of the sprites and portraits have to be named: NameGenderVersion.png
Theres a File CHD New as a example, so you can use it as template and create your own pack

Added Portraits and Sprites of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120691188]OrangePieUwU[/url].

Now supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] mod by downloading the extension and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6238934]gizzymo[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion.[/url]

The mod Looking for Love it's also compatible. You have to download the main mod Change Dialogues and the extension. Copy the content of
that file on the previusly downloaded and installed original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21370]Looking for Love Redux[/url] from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48380238]foggywizard[/url] and updated by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/143742733]mushroomhash[/url].

The mod Razolyn from misscoriel it's also compatible.
You have to download the main mod Change Dialogues and the extension. Copy the content of
that file on the Mod folder of Stardew Valley.

The Wizard Name will are set depending of:
- If "WizardName" is blank, also "", it takes the name regarding the mod you use. (Razolyn or SVE)
- If you asign other name, it takes that name and didn't change regarding the mod you use.

The mod Dateable Caroline datable from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/175203663]sy_mokarin [/url] and MamaNachona is compatible. You have to download the main mod Change Dialogues and the extension. Copy the content of
that file on the previusly downloaded and installed original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15532]Dateable Caroline[/url].

The mod Marry Morris from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5732946]yoshimax[/url] is compatible. You have to download the main mod Change Dialogues and the extension. Copy the content of

The mod Sam After Dark from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/192766184]loshionbottle[/url] is compatible. You have to download the main mod Change Dialogues and the extension. Copy the content of
that file on the previusly downloaded and installed original mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30615]Sam After Dark[/url].

If you encounter any bug write it and I will look at it.

If you are an modder and you wan't to use the tokens of this mod, you can ask me for help.
Now there's also possible to use this mod for other languages. Just ask me.


Es un mod que cambia los nombres, los chicos los puedes pasar a chicas.
Al cambiar de sexo, cambian los diálogos automáticamente indistintamente de a quién cambies a uno o a todos.
Igual corrige  algunos errores tipográficos de algunos diálogos originales.
También se pueden cambiar los gusanos por un cofre.
Y ahora puedes cambiar el Nombre, Retrato y Sprite de Dusty.

Hay 4 tipos de configuraciones que se encuentran en el archivo config que está en la carpeta "ChangeDialogues":
1. Cambiar el nombre, como "AbigailName": "Ana", hay otras especiales como "AbigailNickname" o "SamLongname".
2. Cambiar de género como "ClintGender": "Female" o "Male".
3. Cambiar la apariencia como "CarolineSprite": "New" para la version
modificada, "Vanilla" para dejar la apariencia Vanilla o "Other" si tienes otro
mod que modifica la apariencia.
4. Cambiar el retrato como “CarolinePortrait”: “HighRes” para la versión de alta resolución, “New” para la versión modificada, " Vanilla" para
dejar la apariencia del juego o “Other” si tienes otro mod que modifica
el retrato.

Usé personajes de otros mods conocidos y algunos los edité.
Los creditos se encuentran en <Permissions and Credits>.
Las imágenes de los personajes que faltan los iré agregando, los diálogos ya están listos.

Añadidos retratos y sprites de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120691188]OrangePieUwU[/url].

Es compatible con el mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url], descargando la extensión y [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url] de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6238934]gizzymo[/url] y que fué traducida por [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76761043]danirz[/url] a la cual corregí en algunas partes.

Compatibilidad del mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21370]Looking for Love Redux[/url] de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48380238]foggywizard[/url] y actualizado por [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/143742733]mushroomhash[/url] al español.

Agregué la compatibilidad con el mod Razolyn de misscoriel, usé la traducción de Josekill11 y corregí algunos errores de traducción. Tienes que descargar el mod principal Change Dialogues y la extensión.

El nombre del mago cambia según:
- Si la variable WizardName está en blanco, osea "". Toma el nombre dependiendo del mod que hayas instalado.(Razolyn o SVE).
- Si le has puesto un nombre, va a usar ese nombre y no cambia si instalas los otros mods.

Ahora puedes usar el mod [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] para cambiar la configuración.

[b]Nuevo
Ahora puedes añadir tus propios Retratos y Sprites.
[/b]Cambia el nombre de los archivos como: "Nombre de Aldeano+Género+Título" ejemplo "AbigailFemaleMine.png"
y colócalo en "[CD]Change Dialogues/assets/Portraits" o "[CD][CD]Change Dialogues/assets/Characters"
en la configuración de GMCM, puedes elegir el nuevo Retrato o Sprite en el menú desplegable como "Mine" o el Título que escribiste.

Si encuentras algún error, escribelo en los comentarios y lo corregiré.

Si tienen preguntas o quieren ayuda para este u otro mod dejo el enlace Discord de [url=https://discord.gg/6aGmQBt9kW]Stardew Valley Español.
